name: Fenadiazole
summary: Fenadiazole (INNTooltip International Nonproprietary Name; also known as phénadiazole (DCFTooltip Dénomination Commune Française); brand names Hypnazol, Eudormil, and Viodor) is a hypnotic and sedative medication which has been used to treat insomnia but is no longer marketed.
